description: Along any filter, two sets are eventually equal if and only if each is eventually contained in the other; specialize to the cofinite filter for finite-error equality.
signature: Filter.eventuallySubset_antisymm_iff.{u} {α : Type u} {s t : Set α} {l : Filter α} : s =ᶠ[l] t ↔ s ≤ᶠ[l] t ∧ t ≤ᶠ[l] s
